about: Ayat al-Kursi (2:255) is shown on 8 cards but recited in one file. Each card plays its own stretch of 002255.mp3, in seconds. Husary's teaching recitation reads 2:255 as 10 phrases, each followed by a pause for the child to repeat; the cut points are the edges of those pauses (ffmpeg silencedetect, -38 dB, 0.6 s), and each phrase was transcribed with local Whisper (large-v3-turbo) to confirm which words it holds (2026-11-18). Card 1 = phrases 1-2, card 8 = phrases 9-10, every other card is one phrase. 'to' keeps about 2.5 s of the repeat pause.

phrases: له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض
من ذا الذي يشفع عنده إلا بإذنه
يعلم ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم
ولا يحيطون بشيء من علمه إلا بما شاء
